title: Trastuzumab Deruxtecan (T-DXd) in Patients Who Have Hormone Receptor-negative and Hormone Receptor-positive HER2-low or HER2 IHC 0 Metastatic Breast Cancer

rules.rule_text: Age 18 years or older
rules.source_text: Minimum age: 18 Years

rules.rule_text: Sign and date the main informed consent form
rules.source_text: Sign and date the main informed consent form

rules.rule_text: Must agree to provide newly obtained or archival baseline biopsy from primary and/or metastatic lesion
rules.source_text: Must agree to provide a newly obtained or archival baseline biopsy from primary and/or metastatic lesion.

rules.rule_text: Pathologically documented breast cancer tumor
rules.source_text: Pathologically documented Breast Cancer (BC) tumor

rules.rule_text: Breast cancer is unresectable and/or metastatic
rules.source_text: Is unresectable and/or metastatic.

rules.rule_text: Hormone receptor status is hormone receptor-negative or hormone receptor-positive
rules.source_text: Is hormone receptor-negative or hormone receptor-positive.

rules.rule_text: Biopsy must include percentage of positively stained cells to characterize hormone receptor status
rules.source_text: Must include percentage of positively stained cells to characterize if hormone receptor-positive or -negative.

rules.rule_text: HER2 status is IHC 1+ or IHC 2+/ISH- (HER2-low) or IHC 0 per ASCO CAP 2018 guidelines
rules.source_text: Has confirmed HER2 IHC 1+ or IHC 2+/ISH- (HER2-low) status or HER2 IHC 0 status as determined according to ASCO CAP 2018 guidelines1 based on sample collected during Tissue Screening as described above.

rules.rule_text: Was never previously HER2-positive (IHC 3+ or IHC 2+/ISH+) on prior pathology testing
rules.source_text: Was never previously HER2-positive (IHC 3+ or IHC 2+/ISH+) on prior pathology testing (per ASCO CAP guidelines).

rules.rule_text: Was never previously treated with anti-HER2 therapy in the metastatic setting
rules.source_text: Was never previously treated with anti-HER2 therapy in the metastatic setting.

rules.rule_text: Has had at least one and up to two prior lines of therapy in the metastatic setting
rules.source_text: Has had at least one and up to two prior lines of therapy in the metastatic setting.

rules.rule_text: For hormone receptor-positive HER2-low metastatic BC: has recurrent disease less than 2 years from initiation of adjuvant ET
rules.source_text: Has recurrent disease <2 years from the initiation of adjuvant ET OR

rules.rule_text: For hormone receptor-positive HER2-low metastatic BC: has disease progression on CDK4/6 inhibitor-based regimen within 12 months of completion of adjuvant therapy with CDK4/6 inhibitor
rules.source_text: Has disease progression on CDK4/6 inhibitor-based regimen within 12 months of completion of adjuvant therapy with a CDK4/6 inhibitor OR

rules.rule_text: For hormone receptor-positive HER2-low metastatic BC: has disease progression within the first 12 months of CDK4/6 in the first line metastatic setting
rules.source_text: Has disease progression within the first 12 months of CDK4/6 in the first line metastatic setting

rules.rule_text: Presence of at least one measurable lesion based on computed tomography or magnetic resonance imaging
rules.source_text: Presence of at least one measurable lesion based on computed tomography or magnetic resonance imaging.

rules.rule_text: Brain metastases are small (<2 cm), untreated, asymptomatic, not requiring urgent medical intervention, and clinically stable
rules.source_text: Participants with brain metastases are allowed in the study. The brain lesion(s) should be small (<2 cm), untreated, asymptomatic, not requiring urgent medical intervention, and are asymptomatic and clinically stable.
rules.notes: Applies only if patient has brain metastases

rules.rule_text: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status of 0 or 1
rules.source_text: Has an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status of 0 or 1.

rules.rule_text: Minimum life expectancy of 12 weeks at Screening
rules.source_text: Has a minimum life expectancy of 12 weeks at Screening.

rules.rule_text: Left ventricular ejection fraction ≥50% within 28 days before enrollment
rules.source_text: Has a left ventricular ejection fraction ≥50% within 28 days before enrollment.

rules.rule_text: Has adequate organ and bone marrow function within 28 days before enrollment
rules.source_text: Has adequate organ and bone marrow function within 28 days before enrollment.
rules.notes: Specific thresholds not provided; requires clinical assessment

rules.rule_text: Has adequate treatment washout period before enrollment
rules.source_text: Has adequate treatment washout period before enrollment.

rules.rule_text: Male and female subjects of reproductive/childbearing potential must agree to use a highly effective form of contraception
rules.source_text: Male and female subjects of reproductive/childbearing potential must agree to use a highly effective form of contraception.

rules.rule_text: Prior treatment with an antibody drug conjugate (ADC)
rules.source_text: Prior treatment with an antibody drug conjugate (ADC).

rules.rule_text: Uncontrolled or significant cardiovascular disease
rules.source_text: Uncontrolled or significant cardiovascular disease.

rules.rule_text: Has a corrected QT interval prolongation
rules.source_text: Has a corrected QT interval prolongation.

rules.rule_text: Has a history of (non-infectious) interstitial lung disease (ILD)/pneumonitis that required steroids, has current ILD/pneumonitis, or where suspected ILD/pneumonitis cannot be ruled out by imaging at Screening
rules.source_text: Has a history of (non-infectious) interstitial lung disease (ILD)/pneumonitis that required steroids, has current ILD/pneumonitis, or where suspected ILD/pneumonitis cannot be ruled out by imaging at Screening.

rules.rule_text: Has spinal cord compression or clinically active central nervous system metastases
rules.source_text: Has spinal cord compression or clinically active central nervous system metastases.

rules.rule_text: Has multiple primary malignancies within 3 years, except adequately resected non-melanoma skin cancer, curatively treated in situ disease, other solid tumors curatively treated, or contralateral BC
rules.source_text: Has multiple primary malignancies within 3 years, except adequately resected non-melanoma skin cancer, curatively treated in situ disease, other solid tumors curatively treated, or contralateral BC.

rules.rule_text: Has a history of severe hypersensitivity reactions to either the drug substances or inactive ingredients in the drug product
rules.source_text: Has a history of severe hypersensitivity reactions to either the drug substances or inactive ingredients in the drug product.

rules.rule_text: Has a history of severe hypersensitivity reactions to other monoclonal antibodies
rules.source_text: Has a history of severe hypersensitivity reactions to other monoclonal antibodies.

rules.rule_text: Has an uncontrolled infection requiring intravenous (IV) antibiotics, antivirals, or antifungals
rules.source_text: Has an uncontrolled infection requiring intravenous (IV) antibiotics, antivirals, or antifungals.

rules.rule_text: Active primary immunodeficiency, known uncontrolled active HIV infection, or active hepatitis B or C infection
rules.source_text: Active primary immunodeficiency, known uncontrolled active human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection, or active hepatitis B or C infection.

rules.rule_text: Has history of receiving a live, attenuated vaccine within 30 days prior to first exposure to study drug
rules.source_text: Has history of receiving a live, attenuated vaccine (messenger RNA and replication-deficient adenoviral vaccines are not considered attenuated live vaccines) within 30 days prior to the first exposure to study drug.
rules.notes: mRNA and replication-deficient adenoviral vaccines are not considered attenuated live vaccines

rules.rule_text: Has unresolved toxicities from previous anticancer therapy, defined as toxicities (other than alopecia) not yet resolved to Grade ≤1 or baseline
rules.source_text: Has unresolved toxicities from previous anticancer therapy, defined as toxicities (other than alopecia) not yet resolved to Grade ≤1 or baseline.

rules.rule_text: Is pregnant or breastfeeding or planning to become pregnant
rules.source_text: Is pregnant or breastfeeding or planning to become pregnant.

rules.rule_text: Lung-specific intercurrent clinically significant illnesses
rules.source_text: Lung-specific intercurrent clinically significant illnesses.

rules.rule_text: Any autoimmune, connective tissue, or inflammatory disorders
rules.source_text: Any autoimmune, connective tissue, or inflammatory disorders.

rules.rule_text: Prior complete pneumonectomy
rules.source_text: Prior complete pneumonectomy.
